errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the blue circular markers present at each data point along the red line.
The description states the peak is 40.7 in 2008. The actual peak occurs in 2009 with a value of approximately 39.8. Both the year and the value for the peak are incorrect.
The description claims the value rises to 36.5 in 2015. The actual value in 2015 is approximately 35.6. The value of approximately 36.5 is reached in 2022, not 2015.
The description states the line drops to 32 in 2020. According to the chart, the value in 2020 is approximately 35.9. The value 32 is significantly lower than the actual data point.
